categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates static unit test corpora in src/test/data/script_tests.json and tx_invalid.json.
categories.rationale: Adds static script and transaction test vectors covering consensus and policy interpreter edge cases. The additions test OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY negative operands, OP_IFDUP zero edge cases, invalid Taproot curve x-coordinates, and single-flag executions for downstream suites copying the JSON data, but do not affect Bitcoin Core's runtime behavior or fix internal test flakiness.
